free_tier.stated: 8 GB per video reported for most accounts; some accounts higher (third-party guide, not vendor docs)

egress.terms: free playback CDN, but segment/m3u8 delivery with Referer and anti-leech checks — not a plain file GET

tooling: open upload API documented in Chinese (POST /arcopen/fn/archive/video/init, chunked upload above 100 MB); bilibili-API-collect and multiple uploader CLIs exist
chaining: 8 GB x unlimited videos x N verified accounts; 20 TiB = 2,560 uploads. Realistically the biggest single-file social quota found, but each video must pass transcode + review

limits.value: review rejects arbitrary data, so it is a video host, not storage

limits_note: 8 GB/file; mandatory transcode (never byte-exact); content review gate; account must be phone-verified; playback URLs are signed and expire
reliability_note: transcoding destroys the bytes and review rejects arbitrary data, so it is a video host, not storage; CDN URLs are time-signed
